'''Loisya Starkos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she encountered a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] wearing a [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robe]] at the [[Trade Outpost]]. She told the individual that the robe looked a bit ratty, and that she would supply a new robe if the Force user would give her ancient relics found on various [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The Force-sensitive individual agreed, and explored [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] for various ancient relics, all of which were returned to Starkos in exchange for a new robe.<ref name="SWG:RmR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loisya Starkos was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RmR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Loisya Starkos was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]" update, published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
